surfaces.name: incoming_webhooks
surfaces.reason: Chatto accepts compatible text and channel fields at /webhooks/incoming/:credential, but it does not implement the complete payload, response, rate-limit, or install contract.

surfaces.name: web_api
surfaces.reason: The /api/{method} gateway implements the Phase 1 foundation methods and returns not_implemented for all other methods.

surfaces.name: oauth_v2
surfaces.reason: Chatto supports browser approval and exact bot-token exchange. User tokens, enterprise installs, and rotating-token exchange are not supported.

surfaces.name: app_manifests
surfaces.reason: The Server Admin service validates, preserves, stores, and exports manifests, but target apps.manifest Web API routes do not exist.

surfaces.name: request_url_events
surfaces.reason: Existing outbound bot webhooks cover selected messages only and use a different best-effort contract.

surfaces.name: socket_mode
surfaces.reason: The native protobuf realtime protocol is not Socket Mode.

surfaces.name: slash_commands
surfaces.reason: No command registration or interaction delivery service exists.

surfaces.name: interactivity
surfaces.reason: No signed actions, shortcuts, options, views, or response_url service exists.

surfaces.name: block_kit
surfaces.reason: Messages store Chatto text and attachments; clients do not render the target structured surfaces.

surfaces.name: level_3_egress_gateway
surfaces.reason: No host-interception gateway or private-CA deployment package exists.
